messages.subject: autoBlock error message
parts:
Hey all,

I'm sleuthing for fitting a survival model and I'm trying to do a run using the convenient autoBlock flag within the configureMCMC() function. The model successfully configures and can be run without including autoBlock=TRUE. But removing everything but the model statement + the autoblock flag, I've been getting an error message.

confMCMC <- configureMCMC(Rmodel,autoBlock = TRUE,autoIt=10000)

The error message is:

checking model sizes and dimensions...Error in gm_message(...) : unused argument (appendLF = FALSE)

Any ideas? Seems like something on the back end. I can send reproducible code if needed off list. Using versionn nimble 0.9

Thanks!
Alison
